sahneler.metin: Sweden's mighty warship Vasa sank minutes into its maiden voyage.
Within minutes, a gust tipped it over and it went down.
It carried heavy guns on two decks.
Its hull was narrow, with too little ballast below.
Before launch, sailors running across the deck made it roll dangerously.
Today, Vasa is a classic lesson in why stability comes first.

aciklama:
Vasa capsized minutes into its maiden voyage. The cause: insufficient stability: too much weight high up and too little ballast below.
